notes.title: [Update] Ver.2.06.05 (April 12, 2024)
notes.content:
Hello everyone,
We've made several adjustments to [Cross Soul].

[h3]Update Highlights [/h3]

    Implemented a lightweight mode (accessible via options, reduces some backgrounds/effects for better performance).
    Achievement conditions are now visible in-game.
    Adjusted game balance for smoother play.
    Enhanced game pace and visuals.
    Fixed various bugs.

We're also planning more updates and content additions. Stay tuned!

notes.title: [Full Release Migration Version] Ver.1.04.07 (2021/11/06)
notes.content:
Thanks for your help😌.
This will be the full release transition version, and early access will be closed.
(There are still some bugs in the display, etc.).

For a variety of reasons, we decided to release it as free.
This game was actually quite overwhelming, and without your help, it would have probably been abandoned at a very early stage.
Thank you very much for your help!

[h2]◇◆Updates◆◇[/h2].
-Added extra dungeons.
 Two major types; one is a short one with high difficulty that can be challenged by either Aoha or Ahsamooha.
 The other is a special dungeon for Aoha only.

-The fishing activity has been improved.
 Previously, you could only leave it for a long time, but now you can choose between leaving it (for a shorter time) or playing a mini-game to match the timing. The catch is the same.

-New dungeon related 3 achievements have been added.

-Warehouse has been expanded. It will now hold 500 of each item type.
 *There is still a bug that the possession icon is not displayed on the second page of the weapon or the possession name is displayed differently than it actually is. This does not affect the data.

-Some other improvements have been made to the display and presentation.


[h3]About the future schedule[/h3]
For Cross Soul, unless there is some kind of big trigger, we will be focusing on new products rather than adding content.
However, we will continue to fix bugs and respond to feedback.

We are currently working on a major new game.
We were working on the action game [WwRA] (tentative title), however  we decided to slow it down. (Economic damage to family due to covid, etc.)
To make up for this, we will move up the production of the RPG that was scheduled to start in December.

We hope you will support us in our future works...!
I've released [No Ghost in Stay Home] directly because it was a very small game.
I'm considering early access for the above two new works.

We hope you will help us again.
And if you notice anything about Cross Soul, please let us know!

Have a good day and take care of yourself 😉.

notes.title: [Update] Ver.1.02.08 (June 23, 2021)
notes.content:
Thanks for your patience 🤗


[Update]
Improved BGM for the final battle.

[Bug Fixes]
In the weapon inventory, the scrolling selection was misaligned with the actual position.
The names of all monsters in the Banamaggedon family are displayed as "Banamaggedon".
Some of the icons in the item details were different.
Eggs did not heal when used.
Wait time did not occur for some weapons during spear attacks on the ground.
When using a spear attack in the air or critical, the waiting time was the same for all weapons.
All items on the map were sometimes replaced after defeating the Anu type (bow).

notes.title: [Update] Ver.1.01.33 (2021/06/07)
notes.content:
Thanks for your patience, and here's an update.
This time, only bug fixes.

There is no end to the bugs.
There are only a limited number of things I can find in my own test play, so feedback helps me a lot.

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
The main menu did not appear after the credits were displayed.
The credits could not be displayed again after interrupting the credits
The name of the equipped weapon of the shadow/black dragon was not displayed.
The attack graphics of some weapons were not displayed correctly.
The icons of some items are different from the original ones.
The background of some items is displayed before the character.
In the Unga Village Festival, there were cases where the character in the yagura protruded into the air on the right side.
In the festival of Unga Village, some dialogs were displayed repeatedly.
When controlling Aoha, Anu's archmaster did not hit the reflection arrow.
When taking damage from the Wheel Eye, the damage display color is now white (enemy damage).
The name displayed when acquiring some items was different from the actual name.
The player could not escape from the deepest part of the Labyrinth of spirit.
The boss graphic of Abyssal Cloister B was not displayed.
The details of items were not displayed on the blacksmithing screen.
Some material icons were not displayed in the blacksmithing screen.
Blacksmithing could be performed even when food/equipment was full.
In the blacksmithing screen, some material icons did not appear.
When an enemy dropped an item, a rectangle with the word "item" on it was visible for a moment.
When the Banamageddon was facing right, it did not attack.
No damage was generated by the direct attack of the Banamageddon.
In the crafting screen, when crafting is executed immediately after moving the cursor, it is executed in the menu before moving.
In the crafting screen, when crafting right after moving the cursor, the crafting would be executed in the menu before moving.
When you were attacked by a large number of enemies at the same time, you could not take any damage until the next floor.
The damage of shuriken against Abyssal Almee was negative (HP increased).
A red square would momentarily appear in the sky above the Unga facility (fast move point).


It seems that there are still some bugs that we were not able to reproduce.
We will investigate the cause and fix them as soon as we can reproduce them here.

Please continue to send us your feedback if you notice any issues.
Thank you for your continued support!

notes.title: [Update] Ver.1.01.22 (2021/05/29)
notes.content:
Thanks for your help!

There is still no word on whether we will release the full version for a fee or for free.
It is a hard decision for us to make, but it could be free for everyone.
The reason is that it is difficult to make it permanently free for "users who participated in early access but uninstalled it once.

Releasing the game for free is a big financial blow for us.
However, we will continue to think about sequels and other titles to make up for it.
We hope you will continue to support us.
We probably won't be doing any special style of early access in the future! 😭


Thank you again for your valuable feedback!

[h3]Updates[/h3]
After clearing the game, the ending BGM will be played at the location of the last scene.
Added new weapons [Golden Kunai / Golden Valour].
Added craftable items.
[Seal of Burnt explosion] [Golden Knife/Golden Valour] [Golden Hummer (after clearing the story)]
You can now craft [Gunpowder] [Gold] [(rare items obtained by fishing)], which were previously unavailable.

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
The name with negative effects did not work properly.
When removing an item from a chest, the item could be duplicated under certain conditions.
When saving in the Abyssal Cloister, the game could not be restarted from within the dungeon.
Even if you save with keyboard setting 2, the setting is changed to 1 when loading.
When a player is hit by a swallowing attack at the moment of an Iai slash, the player may lose control.
When picking up items, the item names of some items are not displayed.
When picking up items, some item names were not displayed.
After challenging the Abyssal Cloister, graphics and sound did not display/play properly when challenging another dungeon.
The description of some items did not appear in the inventory.
After reincarnating from Unga to Rahalm, the reincarnation effect is displayed even when moving normally.
The waiting time for weapons was not set correctly.
Subweapons did not appear in the Abyssal Cloister.
Sub-weapons did not appear in the Abyssal Cloister. - Locked treasure chests did not appear in the Abyssal Cloister.
In Abyssal Cloister B and Abyssal Cloister C, the map name was displayed in Arabic even if the Japanese setting was set.
After the second floor of Abyssal Cloister B, the screen shifted to Abyssal Cloister A.
In the Abyssal Cloister B, after the second floor of the Abyssal Cloister B, the map switches to the Abyssal Cloister A.
In the Rahalm version, "Abyssal Cloister" is displayed as "Abyssal Labyrinth" in the fast-move selection.
In the fast-move selection of the Rahalm version, the restrictions on bringing items into the Abyssal Cloister are not displayed.
Depending on the order in which you talk to the inhabitants of the Unga Festival, the dialogue may not be displayed correctly.
Only the Hungry Lizard's graphic was sometimes displayed in the upper left corner of the map.

Other minor bug fixes and adjustments


Please continue to send us your feedback if you notice anything.
We're sorry that we can't implement some of them, but we're working on them as much as we can.
Thank you for your continued support!

notes.title: [Adjustment Update] Ver.1.00.02 (2021/04/14)
notes.content:
Well done to all the early access participants! ːsteamhappyː
It's been about 1 year and 8 months since v0.00.01, and about 1 year since the Steam release.
With your support, we have finally reached Ver.1.

Thank you for all the feedback and support.
It has been a great support, not only for the game content, but also for the mental aspect.
As I am the only one who is responsible for programming and integrating the game
In the latter half of the game, I was overloaded with tasks and felt dizzy, but thanks to you, I was able to overcome the most difficult time.

With this update, we were able to eliminate the obvious shortcomings, implement the extra dungeons.
The game is now at least as complete as it could be.
However, we believe that we still need to brush up.
Please continue to play and give us feedback, it would be greatly appreciated!


[h2]About Early Access Continuation and the Full Version[/h2]

We've been promising from the beginning that [b][u]Early Access participants will get permanent free play[/u][/b]
I requested support from the management again, and they said that I needed to "associate it with a user account".
(You can continue to play for free without doing anything, but in that case, you will not be able to play after uninstalling.)
The management said that they could not support "association" directly.

We will try to find a better way.
For this reason, (I was thinking of making the product version, but) I will extend the early access a bit more.
I've also posted about this on the forums.
https://steamcommunity.com/app/1275210/discussions/0/3167694551629791596/
If anyone is familiar with Steam and knows of a better way to do this, please let me know.
I'll also check with the original distributor of Clickteam Fusion (development software).

If we can't find the best way to do this, you'll have to consider making the full version free!
I would appreciate it if you could understand this. (This is a very difficult choice for me, because of the cost.)


[h2]The biggest update[/h2]
We've added an extra dungeon. There is one big one, with three patterns.
Added 37 achievements, which should unlock Steam achievements as well.
　(If you have already advanced the game, some of them will be unlocked at startup.)
As-salaam alaikum!　What a surprise! Arabic is now supported.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37378564/230c8ccb8ce0a24b6177eab62a5c628070f5fea5.jpg[/img]


[h2]Other important updates[/h2]
Added a new startup screen (Midori Games logo).
A possessed monster appears in the extra dungeon.
　(It has a soul icon and has been strengthened to the extreme.)
Added dungeon map pattern.
Added a hounted name.
Implemented the Golden Hummer (forging possessed weapons).
Added town changes, mob characters, and conversations.
Added monsters.
Added BGM.
Added SE when attacking monsters
Significantly increased the power of 3-way magic arrows


[h3]Bug fixes and adjustments[/h3] 
Fixed an underflow in attack damage (damage values would be tens of thousands when calculated to be less than 1).
Fixed a CTD when closing inventory with many hounted weapons.
Fixed the position of the hounted icon shifting.

Other minor bug fixes and adjustments.


[h2]unfinished parts[/h2]
The ending BGM could be played more than once.
The pattern of the special floor is not enough.
Add items related to extra dungeons.
Some staging issues (location of water and decorations in dungeons)
Some of them are in Arabic.


[h3]About the future schedule[/h3]
It's not complete yet, but let me give you a break.
However, we are always working on minor bug fixes and updates.

One of the reasons is to prepare for the release of the full version, and
the other is to think about the future of Cross Soul, and to maintain motivation.
We have decided that this is the best time to start developing a new game.

As for the new game, we have two smaller games.
I'm planning to make two smaller games, a simpler action game and my first horror game.
We believe that taking on a variety of genres will be beneficial to this project.

Please continue to support Cross Soul, and hopefully the new one!

notes.title: [Adjustment Update] Ver.0.33.15 (2020/05/29)
notes.content:
Hi there! Thank you for waiting ~ ːsteamhappyː
Thanks to everyone's feedback, we've made a lot of successful brushups.
We are sorry that we have not been able to respond to all of these issues, and we will continue to make improvements in the future.

This time it is not an update on new content (continuation of the story), but a basis for that.
A total of 44 improvements have been made. Lots of bug fixes, tweaks, usability improvements, and more.
Please see the special site below for detailed support status.
[url=http://midoriko.sakura.ne.jp/files/games/crosssoul/crosssoul_index.html]Cross Soul Official page[/url]

If there are any new points you notice, or that you feel that improvement is insufficient,
Please continue to give us feedback!

[h2] ◇ ◆ Important update ◆ ◇ [/h2]
[h3] [*] Implemented a key config that was requested a lot.
You can also open the option screen at any time except during a conversation. [/h3]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/37378564/3b38078fd2236c431013503c8359366d6d18dd5c.jpg[/img]

* ◁ button or Esc key (also possible when operating the controller)
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/37378564/1d75db31fb95df3f46841e878d5720095e894129.jpg[/img]

[Keyboard1]: The operation method is the same as before.
Use the arrow keys (right hand) to move and the ZXCS keys to perform action operations.

[Keyboard2]: New operation method.
Use WASD keys (left hand) to move and IJKL keys to perform action operations.

Added operation popups on the title screen and option screen.


[h3] [*] The reflection arrow of Ahsamooha has been changed to "Magic Arrow" and has been significantly strengthened. [/h3]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/37378564/1b76ef5573d7f5bcbff75d6058900c251da843f1.jpg[/img]

You can choose from 3 types to shoot.
[Reflection]: Fires a reflection /penetration arrow as before. Effective in narrow spaces.
[3way]: Fire magic arrows in 3 directions. At present, it is not very convenient, so adjust it.
[Boost]: Uses 20 Stamina and shoots a high-power, wide-judgment penetrating arrow.
Also, you can use the cancel button to close the arrow when holding it with both normal and magic arrows.


[h3] [*] St recovery specifications have changed. [/h3]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/37378564/476cbbb661104ed6aad5c1ccaa84931f128ee95e.jpg[/img]
The gauge glows green by not operating for a certain period of time,
Your stamina recovers faster (up to 20 for Aoha and 10 for Ahsamooha).
You no longer have to wait a long time to move,
Ahsamooha must consume stamina recovery items to shoot boost magic arrows.

[h3]
[*] Depending on remaining HP at pinch
The HP gauge is now glowing red. (Alarm when HP is less than 1/10)
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/37378564/19a2bc4f76a8d79ed50346f1105456197e8ebf85.jpg[/img]
[h3]
[*] Game over is simple but implemented.
All possessed items will be lost except for equipped weapon.

[*] At the time of memory reincarnation (change of Unga ⇔ Rahalm)
A special performance screen is now displayed. [/h3]


others,
● Updated the map background.
● SE about the action of the main character was added.
● Full screen display supported
● Supports changing resolution (window size)
● Bundled readme file [/h3]
Many other adjustments and bug fixes have been made.

[h3]That's all, so please download and check it out! [/h3](Version is 0.33.15)
